The answer: TRACKING. Most people fell for "safety". Here's why 👇

Rule: don't write the first word that fits the gap. Wait for the paraphrase.

Check your real CD IELTS level: link in bio.

#ielts #ieltslistening #ieltsmock #ieltsuzbekistan #cdielts

✅ Answer: TRACKING "safety of satellites" fits the gap perfectly, and that's the trap. The question says few systems. The speaker says we don't have anything like enough proper ways of tracking them. Same idea, different words. And watch your spelling: trucking ≠ tracking. 📌 Rule: don't write the first word that fits. Wait for the paraphrase.

Multilevel Writing: ball yöqotadigan 3 ta oddiy xato 1. Run-on sentence. Ikki gapni faqat vergul bilan ulamang. ❌ I love my city, it is very green. ✅ I love my city because it is very green. 2. Savolga javob bermaslik. Topşiriq "why" deb sörasa, sababni yozing. Umumiy gap ball bermaydi. 3. Bir sözni takrorlaş. Har gapda good örniga: useful, enjoyable, convenient. Three traps on the CD IELTS Listening screen 🎧

1. The audio plays once. There is no pause and no replay, so your focus has to stay on the recording.
2. You type your answers while you listen. A spelling mistake makes the answer wrong, so practise typing words correctly under pressure.
3. The timer keeps running, even between parts. Use every pause to read the next questions.
